name: default
description: WordPress-on-Worker zone cache (deploy/zone, CR #18): bypass dynamic/admin/session, cache anonymous HTML at the edge. @HOSTNAME@ is substituted by apply.sh.

rules.description: Bypass cache for admin, auth, API, cron, cart/checkout/account, any logged-in or cart cookie, and any non-GET method
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-login")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-json")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-cron")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/my-account")) or (http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in") or (http.cookie contains "wp-postpass") or (http.cookie contains "woocommerce_items_in_cart") or (http.cookie contains "woocommerce_cart_hash") or (http.request.method ne "GET")

rules.description: Cache anonymous HTML for this host at the edge (origin is the Worker)
